name: bst_refactor_min_max
task: BinarySearchTree::min_value() and BinarySearchTree::max_value() duplicate the same traversal loop, differing only in whether they follow left or right child pointers. Refactor them to eliminate the duplication by extracting a shared private helper (e.g. extreme_node(bool go_left)) and have both public methods use it. Keep the public signatures and behavior unchanged, including throwing std::out_of_range when called on an empty tree.
